description: Resource-level access policy (security/access.py). A tenant owns a set of services; a principal can read incidents, deployments, logs and runbooks only for services of its own tenant that it is granted. Runbooks are mapped to the services they cover; '*' means every service of the reader's tenant. Anything not listed here is denied. The data files carry no tenant field: tenancy is this partition of services. This repository runs one tenant ('default') that owns all seven services.
